item.text: {"facts":[{"source_id":"SRC-a7dddf74c65f420a","start_unit":5,"end_unit":6,"fact_summary":"The Constitutional Court confirmed the CENI's 2023 presidential result, declaring Félix Tshisekedi elected with 13,058,962 votes (73.47%); it rejected Théodore Ngoy's petition as unfounded for insufficient proof and lack of determinative effect of alleged irregularities, and rejected another petition for lack of standing.","question_ids":["4B.1","4B.4","4B.10","7B.6"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The election occurred in December 2023, but the judicial confirmation was issued on 9 January 2024.","ruler_attribution":"The ruling concerned Tshisekedi's 2023 reelection while he was incumbent.","limitations":["This report records the Court's reasoning and outcome, not an independent assessment of the election's integrity."]},{"source_id":"SRC-62862e2c39557830","start_unit":5,"end_unit":6,"fact_summary":"Tshisekedi convened a three-day national round table to evaluate the state of siege in Ituri and North Kivu, stating that the exceptional regime should not continue indefinitely and seeking recommendations on whether to maintain, requalify, or lift it.","question_ids":["3B.5","3B.9","8B.8","8B.9"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"The round table was launched on 14 August 2023.","ruler_attribution":"Tshisekedi said he had activated the constitutional state-of-siege mechanism to counter grave threats and secure people and property.","limitations":["The source does not report the round table's recommendations or a subsequent decision, implementation, or security outcome."]},{"source_id":"SRC-62862e2c39557830","start_unit":6,"end_unit":6,"fact_summary":"Tshisekedi called on armed groups to lay down their weapons and join the P-DDRCS program, describing it as a good-faith final peaceful exit for remaining rebels.","question_ids":["2B.1","2B.7","3B.9","8B.9"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"The appeal was made in August 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The appeal was made by Tshisekedi as head of state and was presented as a government commitment.","limitations":["The source does not establish participation, funding, implementation, or results of the disarmament program."]},{"source_id":"SRC-97eb729c529c837f","start_unit":2,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"Amnesty reported that M23 fighters committed killings and widespread sexual violence in Kishishe and surrounding villages, that close to one million people were displaced by ongoing fighting, and that little had been done to investigate the abuses or preserve evidence; the Congolese government called on the ICC to investigate and the ICC announced a preliminary investigation.","question_ids":["2B.4","2B.9","3B.1","3B.6","3B.7","3B.10"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The abuses began in November 2022, while the report describes continued violence and accountability developments during 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The source attributes the abuses to M23; it attributes the ICC request to the Congolese government, but does not specify Tshisekedi's personal role beyond that government action.","limitations":["The source does not establish that Tshisekedi personally directed, tolerated, or remedied the reported abuses."]},{"source_id":"SRC-fc22632a00f4eebc","start_unit":5,"end_unit":6,"fact_summary":"The CENI's provisional results for the 20 December 2023 presidential election gave Tshisekedi 73.34% and Moïse Katumbi 18.08%; the report says Tshisekedi's Union sacrée coalition and provincial governors campaigned for him.","question_ids":["4B.1","4B.2","8B.3"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The result and campaign activity occurred in December 2023.","ruler_attribution":"Tshisekedi was the incumbent candidate and beneficiary of the coalition campaign.","limitations":["The source reports provisional results and political support but does not independently assess fairness, coercion, or misuse of state resources."]},{"source_id":"SRC-fc22632a00f4eebc","start_unit":6,"end_unit":6,"fact_summary":"During his 2023 campaign, Tshisekedi promised to continue or strengthen universal health coverage, free basic education, free maternity and newborn care, the 145-territory development program, agriculture and infrastructure projects, and private-sector and entrepreneurship support to reduce unemployment.","question_ids":["5B.1","5B.6","5B.9","6B.1","6B.2","8B.1"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"These were campaign commitments made during the 2023 election period.","ruler_attribution":"The commitments were attributed directly to Tshisekedi.","limitations":["The source does not establish enacted budgets, implementation, execution quality, or outcomes during 2023."]},{"source_id":"SRC-8dc17dbc3e62941a","start_unit":1,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"The Constitutional Court confirmed Tshisekedi's reelection with 13,058,962 votes (73.47%) and annulled all presidential-election votes in Yakoma and Masimanimba as previously announced by the CENI; the report also states that elections extended from 20 to 27 December and that opposition candidates denounced fraud and irregularities while major opposition candidates did not petition the Court, which they considered subservient to power.","question_ids":["4B.1","4B.4","4B.6","4B.10","7B.6"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The election was held in December 2023; the Court decision was issued on 9 January 2024.","ruler_attribution":"The Court confirmed Tshisekedi's reelection; allegations about the Court's subservience and electoral irregularities were reported claims, not findings attributed to Tshisekedi.","limitations":["The source does not independently verify the fraud allegations or the Court's alleged dependence."]},{"source_id":"SRC-27b8e87960e23988","start_unit":4,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"In his November 2023 state-of-the-nation address, Tshisekedi backed holding the scheduled election despite insecurity and territory outside state control, supported cooperation with international forces while discussing MONUSCO and East African Community force withdrawals, and announced targeted commodity-price and monetary measures to stabilize the Congolese franc.","question_ids":["2B.7","3B.9","4B.1","5B.3","5B.9","8B.1","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The address was delivered on 14 November 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The decisions and announcements were attributed directly to Tshisekedi.","limitations":["The source does not report implementation, funding, later correction, or the effects of the monetary and price measures."]},{"source_id":"SRC-90cc27edfcaf40de","start_unit":4,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"The UN warned in October 2023 that direct confrontation between the DRC and Rwanda was a real risk, citing military reinforcement, lack of high-level dialogue, and persistent hate speech; the report says the DRC and Rwanda both reaffirmed a desire for a peaceful solution while accusing each other of supporting armed groups.","question_ids":["2B.1","2B.7","2B.10","3B.3","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The warning and reported diplomatic positions concerned the 2023 DRC-Rwanda crisis.","ruler_attribution":"The DRC's position was reported through its representatives; the source does not identify which statements or decisions were personally made by Tshisekedi.","limitations":["The source does not establish Tshisekedi's individual responsibility for the military reinforcement or hate speech."]},{"source_id":"SRC-7a7018bab2747d36","start_unit":1,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"The CENCO-ECC electoral observation mission reported conflicting CENI voter totals differing by 450,000 and a further 1,049,792 discrepancy in seat-allocation statistics; it identified 3,706 duplicated polling stations covering 2,244,142 registered voters and an omitted territory, and transmitted the duplicated-station list to the CENI while urging urgent corrections.","question_ids":["4B.1","4B.4","4B.6","4B.10","7B.2","8B.8"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The findings and recommendations were published in November 2023 before the general election.","ruler_attribution":"The findings concern the CENI and the electoral process under Tshisekedi's presidency; the source does not attribute the anomalies personally to Tshisekedi.","limitations":["The source records observer findings and recommendations, not whether the CENI corrected them or whether Tshisekedi acted on them."]},{"source_id":"SRC-5bd22d1ee706f9c4","start_unit":16,"end_unit":17,"fact_summary":"International IDEA reported that the 20 December 2023 elections occurred amid eastern conflict, weak transport infrastructure, and internal displacement; voting was extended in some areas because of logistical and procedural problems, turnout was 41.0% versus 45.4% in 2018, women were underrepresented, and observers reported delayed openings, fights, ransacked or burned polling places; the Supreme Court confirmed the result on 9 January 2024.","question_ids":["4B.1","4B.3","4B.7","4B.10","6B.6","8B.5","8B.6"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The reported election conditions occurred in December 2023; confirmation occurred in January 2024.","ruler_attribution":"The report concerns elections held under Tshisekedi's incumbent administration but does not assign personal responsibility for each logistical or procedural failure.","limitations":["The report does not establish whether problems were deliberate, how government authorities responded, or whether the confirmed result accurately reflected voter intent."]},{"source_id":"SRC-ddc7be3c8deca05c","start_unit":5,"end_unit":6,"fact_summary":"At the first council of the Sama II government, Tshisekedi instructed ministers to treat office as a responsibility serving the general interest, follow government solidarity, deliberation secrecy, hierarchy, and collegiality, prioritize macroeconomic stability and purchasing power, execute the government action program, and promote geographic balance plus women and youth candidates.","question_ids":["5B.1","5B.2","5B.3","5B.6","6B.1","6B.3","7B.5","8B.1","8B.2","8B.4"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"The council and instructions were reported in April 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The directives and expectations were attributed directly to Tshisekedi.","limitations":["The source does not show whether ministers complied, whether appointments were merit-based, or whether the stated priorities produced measurable results."]},{"source_id":"SRC-01d6323e69dc6e46","start_unit":4,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"At a December 2023 campaign rally in Goma, Tshisekedi promised to continue fighting and remove M23, accused Rwanda's Paul Kagame of bringing in the rebels, called their rule barbaric terrorism, urged enlistment in the armed forces, and said 40,000 recruits had already joined; the report says peace efforts appeared stalled.","question_ids":["2B.2","2B.3","2B.8","2B.10","3B.3","8B.3","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The statements and reported recruitment figure concern December 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The rhetoric, recruitment appeal, and claim of 40,000 recruits were attributed directly to Tshisekedi.","limitations":["The source does not independently verify the recruitment figure, the attribution of M23 support, or whether the rhetoric caused escalation."]},{"source_id":"SRC-c6ba4a2aeabc7f62","start_unit":4,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"In September 2023, the Congolese government presented a second white paper alleging Rwandan aggression and M23 support, reporting more than 2.3 million displaced people, destroyed or occupied schools, damage to Virunga National Park, lost customs revenue, and disrupted voter registration in occupied areas; it sought stronger international sanctions and action.","question_ids":["2B.3","2B.5","2B.10","3B.6","3B.7","3B.10","6B.6","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The white paper and diplomatic appeal were presented in September 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The allegations and requests were made by Tshisekedi's government through its ministers; the source does not identify a personal decision by Tshisekedi beyond the government's position.","limitations":["The reported figures and allegations are government claims, although the report says UN experts confirmed Rwandan support for M23; it does not establish policy outcomes."]}],"documents_with_no_material_fact":[],"batch_limitations":["The supplied corpus is concentrated on elections, eastern conflict, state-of-siege governance, and public programs; it contains no material evidence on nuclear, biological, AI, or cyber safeguards, proliferation controls, personal financial conflicts, procurement accountability, detailed social-service execution, or verified macroeconomic outcomes."]}
